rule: one plan, run once; no retry; failed samples stay

payloads.control:
mkdir -p /tmp/taw-k13/control
sleep 120 & child=$!
printf '%s\n' "$child" > /tmp/taw-k13/control/child.pid
printf 'partial\n' > /tmp/taw-k13/control/partial
wait
payloads.concurrent:
mkdir -p /tmp/taw-k13/concurrent
sleep 120 & child=$!
printf '%s\n' "$child" > /tmp/taw-k13/concurrent/child.pid
printf 'partial\n' > /tmp/taw-k13/concurrent/partial
wait
payloads.term:
mkdir -p /tmp/taw-k13/term
sleep 120 & child=$!
printf '%s\n' "$child" > /tmp/taw-k13/term/child.pid
printf 'partial\n' > /tmp/taw-k13/term/partial
wait

inspection.control:
cpid=$(cat /tmp/taw-k13/control/child.pid 2>/dev/null)
if [ -n "$cpid" ] && [ ! -s /tmp/taw-k13/control/shell.of."$cpid" ]; then
  ppid=$(ps -o ppid= -p "$cpid" | tr -d ' ')
  case "$ppid" in ''|1) ;; *)
    printf '%s\n' "$ppid" > /tmp/taw-k13/control/shell.of."$cpid" ;;
  esac
fi
for role in shell child; do
  if [ "$role" = shell ]; then
    pid=$(cat /tmp/taw-k13/control/shell.of."$cpid" 2>/dev/null)
  else
    pid=$cpid
  fi
  if [ -z "$pid" ]; then printf '%s pid=none\n' "$role"; continue; fi
  if err=$(kill -0 "$pid" 2>&1); then state=present
  else case "$err" in
    *[Nn]o\ such\ process*) state=absent ;;
    *) state=unknown ;;
  esac
  fi
  ppid=$(ps -p "$pid" -o ppid= | tr -d ' ')
  cmd=$(ps -p "$pid" -o command= | sed 's/ *$//')
  fmt='%s pid=%s %s ppid=%s command=%s\n'
  printf "$fmt" "$role" "$pid" "$state" "$ppid" "$cmd"
done

cleanup:
state() {
  if err=$(kill -0 "$1" 2>&1); then echo alive
  else case "$err" in *[Nn]o\ such\ process*) echo gone ;; *) echo unknown ;; esac; fi
}
wait_gone() {
  i=0
  while [ "$(state "$1")" = alive ] && [ "$i" -lt "$2" ]; do
    sleep 0.1; i=$((i + 1))
  done
}
outcome=confirmed
for f in /tmp/taw-k13/control/child.pid /tmp/taw-k13/concurrent/child.pid /tmp/taw-k13/term/child.pid; do
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue
  pid=$(cat "$f")
  cmd=$(ps -p "$pid" -o command= | sed 's/ *$//')
  printf '%s pid=%s command=%s\n' "$f" "$pid" "$cmd"
  if [ "$cmd" != "sleep 120" ]; then
    s=$(state "$pid")
    if [ -z "$cmd" ] && [ "$s" = gone ]; then printf 'gone pid=%s\n' "$pid"
    elif [ -n "$cmd" ] && [ "$s" = alive ]; then printf 'other pid=%s\n' "$pid"
    else printf 'unknown pid=%s state=%s\n' "$pid" "$s"; outcome=uncertain; fi
    continue
  fi
  kill -TERM "$pid"
  wait_gone "$pid" 20
  action=terminated
  if [ "$(state "$pid")" = alive ]; then
    kill -KILL "$pid"; action=killed
    wait_gone "$pid" 5
  fi
  s=$(state "$pid")
  if [ "$s" = gone ]; then printf '%s pid=%s\n' "$action" "$pid"
  else printf 'survived pid=%s state=%s\n' "$pid" "$s"; outcome=uncertain; fi
done
printf 'cleanup %s\n' "$outcome"
[ "$outcome" = confirmed ]
